Judge by whether the instrument measures the mechanical state of a component rather than the plasma or its fields.

plasma_measurement_diagnostics -> neutro.label_scope: General plasma-parameter measurement instruments that do not belong to one of the more specific diagnostic families. Judge by whether the instrument measures a plasma parameter directly and has no stronger home above.
plasma_measurement_diagnostics -> neutro.predicted_scope: Neutron and fusion-product measurement and the activation they cause: neutron detection, fusion-product counting and the neutronics of the machine. Judge by whether the quantity concerns neutrons or fusion products and their interactions with materials.

plasma_measurement_diagnostics -> partic.label_scope: General plasma-parameter measurement instruments that do not belong to one of the more specific diagnostic families. Judge by whether the instrument measures a plasma parameter directly and has no stronger home above.
plasma_measurement_diagnostics -> partic.predicted_scope: Diagnostics that count or characterise particles to measure the plasma, chiefly Thomson scattering and other particle-based systems. Judge by whether the instrument works by scattering or collecting particles, rather than by an electromagnetic wave or the radiation the plasma emits.

plasma_measurement_diagnostics -> radiat.label_scope: General plasma-parameter measurement instruments that do not belong to one of the more specific diagnostic families. Judge by whether the instrument measures a plasma parameter directly and has no stronger home above.
plasma_measurement_diagnostics -> radiat.predicted_scope: Diagnostics of the radiation the plasma emits or of the imaging of it: bolometry, X-ray and bremsstrahlung detection, and the visible, IR and X-ray cameras. Judge by whether the instrument records radiated power, photon flux or an image, rather than a spectrum resolved in wavelength.

plasma_measurement_diagnostics -> spectr.label_scope: General plasma-parameter measurement instruments that do not belong to one of the more specific diagnostic families. Judge by whether the instrument measures a plasma parameter directly and has no stronger home above.
plasma_measurement_diagnostics -> spectr.predicted_scope: Passive emission spectroscopy and its analysis: the spectrum of light the plasma emits, resolved in wavelength and interpreted for species, temperature, flows or the motional Stark effect. Judge by whether the quantity is an emission spectrum or an analysis of one.

label_excludes: The plasma heat flux arriving at the target is divertor_physics; the target surface's erosion from it is plasma_wall_interactions.
plasma_wall_interactions -> divertor_phy.label_scope: The interaction between the plasma and the material surfaces it meets: erosion, deposition, material migration, fuel retention and the surface conditions that follow. Judge by whether the quantity is a property of a surface or of the interface rather than of the plasma volume.
predicted_excludes: The plasma arriving at the target is divertor_physics; the surface it erodes is plasma_wall_interactions.
plasma_wall_interactions -> divertor_phy.predicted_scope: The divertor region's plasma and its exhaust of heat and particles: target loads, detachment, the radiation front and the ionisation and recombination in the divertor. Judge by whether the quantity concerns the divertor plasma rather than the edge globally or a wall surface.

plasma_wall_interactions -> gyrokinetics.label_scope: The interaction between the plasma and the material surfaces it meets: erosion, deposition, material migration, fuel retention and the surface conditions that follow. Judge by whether the quantity is a property of a surface or of the interface rather than of the plasma volume.
plasma_wall_interactions -> gyrokinetics.predicted_scope: The gyrokinetic model's own quantities: gyrocenter moments, the gyrokinetic distribution and its fluxes, expressed in the model's normalised coordinates. Judge by whether the quantity is defined within the gyrokinetic framework rather than in measured machine coordinates.

plasma_wall_interactions -> magnetohydro.label_scope: The interaction between the plasma and the material surfaces it meets: erosion, deposition, material migration, fuel retention and the surface conditions that follow. Judge by whether the quantity is a property of a surface or of the interface rather than of the plasma volume.
plasma_wall_interactions -> magnetohydro.predicted_scope: The stability and macroscopic dynamics of a plasma as a conducting fluid: instabilities, their growth and saturation, magnetic reconnection and the events a loss of stability produces. Judge by whether the quantity describes a coherent mode, its mode numbers and growth, or the evolution of a disruption.

plasma_wall_interactions -> radiation_me.label_scope: The interaction between the plasma and the material surfaces it meets: erosion, deposition, material migration, fuel retention and the surface conditions that follow. Judge by whether the quantity is a property of a surface or of the interface rather than of the plasma volume.
plasma_wall_interactions -> radiation_me.predicted_scope: Diagnostics of the radiation the plasma emits or of the imaging of it: bolometry, X-ray and bremsstrahlung detection, and the visible, IR and X-ray cameras. Judge by whether the instrument records radiated power, photon flux or an image, rather than a spectrum resolved in wavelength.

plasma_wall_interactions -> transport.label_scope: The interaction between the plasma and the material surfaces it meets: erosion, deposition, material migration, fuel retention and the surface conditions that follow. Judge by whether the quantity is a property of a surface or of the interface rather than of the plasma volume.
plasma_wall_interactions -> transport.predicted_scope: The rates and sources by which a plasma redistributes particles, energy and momentum, and the coefficients and model parameters that predict them. Judge by whether the quantity measures or models a transport rate, not by the IDS that happens to carry it — an equilibrium IDS with a diffusion model still holds transport quantities.

label_excludes: Recording radiated power, photon flux or an image is radiation_measurement_diagnostics; resolving an emission spectrum is spectroscopy. The failing case this file exists to separate: a spectrometer's line-of-sight emission belongs to spectroscopy, not to radiation_measurement_diagnostics.
radiation_measurement_diagnostics -> spe.label_scope: Diagnostics of the radiation the plasma emits or of the imaging of it: bolometry, X-ray and bremsstrahlung detection, and the visible, IR and X-ray cameras. Judge by whether the instrument records radiated power, photon flux or an image, rather than a spectrum resolved in wavelength.
predicted_excludes: A spectrum resolved in wavelength is spectroscopy; a bolometric power or a camera image is radiation_measurement_diagnostics. The failing case this file exists to separate: a spectrometer's emission is spectroscopy even though a spectrometer measures radiation.
radiation_measurement_diagnostics -> spe.predicted_scope: Passive emission spectroscopy and its analysis: the spectrum of light the plasma emits, resolved in wavelength and interpreted for species, temperature, flows or the motional Stark effect. Judge by whether the quantity is an emission spectrum or an analysis of one.

structural_components -> equilibrium.label_scope: The static engineering structure of the device: vacuum vessel, cryostat, supports and the structural definition of components — materials, geometry and load paths. Judge by whether the quantity describes a structure that holds the machine rather than the plasma physics around it.
structural_components -> equilibrium.predicted_scope: The static magnetic configuration of a plasma in force balance and the coordinate system it is expressed in: the flux-surface geometry, the poloidal flux and its radial derivatives, the safety factor, and the shape of the boundary. Judge by whether the quantity states where the field is and what shape its surfaces have, not by whether it is stored with a time coordinate.

label_excludes: A magnetic coil system is magnetic_field_systems; the passive structure that supports it is structural_components.
structural_components -> magnetic_field_.label_scope: The static engineering structure of the device: vacuum vessel, cryostat, supports and the structural definition of components — materials, geometry and load paths. Judge by whether the quantity describes a structure that holds the machine rather than the plasma physics around it.
structural_components -> magnetic_field_.predicted_scope: The machines that generate and confine the magnetic field: coil systems, superconducting magnets and the iron or ferritic field-shaping infrastructure. Judge by whether the quantity describes the hardware that produces the field rather than the field it produces or measures.

transport -> gyrokinetics.label_scope: The rates and sources by which a plasma redistributes particles, energy and momentum, and the coefficients and model parameters that predict them. Judge by whether the quantity measures or models a transport rate, not by the IDS that happens to carry it — an equilibrium IDS with a diffusion model still holds transport quantities.
predicted_excludes: The model's internal flux is gyrokinetics; the mean transport flux it predicts or that is measured in the plasma is transport.
transport -> gyrokinetics.predicted_scope: The gyrokinetic model's own quantities: gyrocenter moments, the gyrokinetic distribution and its fluxes, expressed in the model's normalised coordinates. Judge by whether the quantity is defined within the gyrokinetic framework rather than in measured machine coordinates.

label_excludes: Hardware and launched power are auxiliary_heating; the wave in the plasma and its propagation are waves.
waves -> auxiliary_heating.label_scope: Electromagnetic waves in a plasma: their propagation, dispersion, mode conversion, damping and wave-particle interaction, and the model quantities a wave code computes. Judge by whether the quantity describes a wave field or its interaction rather than the hardware that launched it.
predicted_excludes: The antenna and the power it delivers are auxiliary_heating; the wave it launches, its dispersion and its wave-particle interaction inside the plasma are waves.
waves -> auxiliary_heating.predicted_scope: The external systems that heat a plasma and their launch and coupling quantities, judged by whether the quantity belongs to a heating actuator or to the power it delivers. The heating method may be beams or waves; what decides the domain is that the quantity is about the injected power, not the transport it later causes.

label_excludes: A wave field inside the plasma is waves; an instrument that probes the plasma with waves and records a signal, such as interferometry, reflectometry or polarimetry, is a diagnostic.
waves -> electromagnetic_wave_diagnostic.label_scope: Electromagnetic waves in a plasma: their propagation, dispersion, mode conversion, damping and wave-particle interaction, and the model quantities a wave code computes. Judge by whether the quantity describes a wave field or its interaction rather than the hardware that launched it.
predicted_excludes: A probe instrument and its measured signal are electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics; the plasma wave physics the probe studies is waves.
waves -> electromagnetic_wave_diagnostic.predicted_scope: Diagnostics that probe the plasma with electromagnetic waves and detect the wave's propagation: interferometry, polarimetry, reflectometry and refractometry. Judge by whether the instrument transmits a wave and measures its phase, polarisation or reflection.

barometry/gauge/pressure.description: Neutral gas pressure measured by a barometry gauge within the vacuum vessel or surrounding vacuum system. Characterizes local gas inventory and vacuum conditions relevant to plasma fuelling, recycling, and neutral gas modelling.
barometry/gauge/pressure.label: particle_measurement_diagnostics

bolometer/camera/channel/aperture/x1_wid.description: Full width of the bolometer channel aperture in the X1 direction, applicable when the aperture geometry type is rectangular (geometry_type=3). Defines the physical extent of the collimating aperture used in étendue calculations.
bolometer/camera/channel/aperture/x1_wid.label: plasma_measurement_diagnostics

bolometer/camera/channel/line_of_sight/f.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of first point.
bolometer/camera/channel/line_of_sight/f.label: plasma_measurement_diagnostics

bolometer/camera/channel/line_of_sight/s.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of second point.
bolometer/camera/channel/line_of_sight/s.label: plasma_measurement_diagnostics

bolometer/power_radiated_total.description: Total radiated power (P_rad) reconstructed from bolometry measurements, integrating broadband electromagnetic emission across the entire plasma volume. A key global energy balance quantity for transport analysis and impurity monitoring.
bolometer/power_radiated_total.label: core_plasma_physics

breeding_blanket/module/layer/time_slice.description: Total nuclear power deposited in a specific breeding blanket layer by neutron heating. Represents the volumetric nuclear heat load from fusion neutron interactions with the blanket material.
breeding_blanket/module/layer/time_slice.label: neutronics

breeding_blanket/module/time_slice/escap.description: Maximum neutron flux escaping from the rear surface of a breeding blanket module. A key shielding performance metric indicating the blanket's effectiveness in attenuating the neutron flux toward the vessel structure.
breeding_blanket/module/time_slice/escap.label: neutronics

bremsstrahlung_visible/channel/filter/wa.description: Upper bound of the wavelength passband for the optical filter in a visible bremsstrahlung channel. Defines the high-wavelength edge of the spectral window selected for effective charge (Zeff) measurements.
bremsstrahlung_visible/channel/filter/wa.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

camera_ir/channel/target_surface_center/.description: Y coordinate of target surface center.
camera_ir/channel/target_surface_center/.label: plasma_wall_interactions

camera_ir/optical_element/geometry/outli.description: Positions of the optical element outline vertices along the x1 axis in the local (X1, X2) coordinate system. Defines part of the irregular cross-sectional boundary of an IR camera optical element.
camera_ir/optical_element/geometry/outli.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

camera_x_rays/detector_temperature.description: Physical temperature of the X-ray camera detector hardware. Relevant for calibration and monitoring of detector operating conditions during plasma measurements.
camera_x_rays/detector_temperature.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

camera_x_rays/filter_window/radius.description: Radius of a circular filter window aperture in the X-ray camera diagnostic, applicable only when the geometry type is set to circular. Defines the physical size of the window through which X-ray photons pass.
camera_x_rays/filter_window/radius.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

camera_x_rays/filter_window/wavelength_u.description: Upper bound of the wavelength passband of the X-ray camera filter window, defining the high-wavelength (low-energy) cutoff of the spectral sensitivity range for the filter.
camera_x_rays/filter_window/wavelength_u.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

charge_exchange/channel/cone_diameter.description: Diameter of the base of the optical cone at the entrance pupil of a CXRS channel. A geometric parameter characterizing the light collection optics of the charge exchange recombination spectroscopy diagnostic.
charge_exchange/channel/cone_diameter.label: plasma_measurement_diagnostics

charge_exchange/channel/ion/n_i_over_n_e.description: Ion concentration of a given impurity or fuel species expressed as the ratio of ion density (ni) to electron density (ne) at the CXRS channel measurement point. Quantifies fractional abundance of the species relative to the electron population.
charge_exchange/channel/ion/n_i_over_n_e.label: core_plasma_physics

charge_exchange/channel/ion/velocity_pol.description: Poloidal velocity (v_pol) of an ion species measured by charge exchange recombination spectroscopy (CXRS) at the channel measurement point. Represents the poloidal component of ion flow derived from Doppler-shifted emission.
charge_exchange/channel/ion/velocity_pol.label: spectroscopy

charge_exchange/channel/ion/z_ion.description: Ion charge state (z_ion) of the measured ion species in charge exchange recombination spectroscopy (CXRS). Specifies the charge number (e.g., C+6, N+7) used to identify the spectral line and interpret the measurement.
charge_exchange/channel/ion/z_ion.label: core_plasma_physics

coils_non_axisymmetric/coil/conductor/el.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of intermediate points.
coils_non_axisymmetric/coil/conductor/el.label: magnetic_field_systems

core_profiles/global_quantities/ip.description: Total plasma current (Ip), the net toroidal current flowing through the plasma column, as stored in the core_profiles global quantities. A primary global parameter for confinement and stability.
core_profiles/global_quantities/ip.label: equilibrium

core_profiles/global_quantities/z_eff_re.description: Volume-averaged effective plasma charge (Zeff) estimated from ohmic resistive flux consumption during the ohmic heating phase. Provides a global impurity content measure derived resistively rather than spectroscopically.
core_profiles/global_quantities/z_eff_re.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/profiles_1d/electrons/temp.description: Electron temperature (Te) radial profile in the core plasma, as a function of normalized flux coordinate. Fundamental to transport, stability, and heating analyses of the bulk electron population.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/electrons/temp.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/psi_bound.description: Poloidal magnetic flux (ψ) at the plasma boundary (last closed flux surface, LCFS), used as the outer normalization reference for the radial ψ grid in core plasma 1D profiles.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/psi_bound.label: equilibrium

core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/rho_pol_n.description: Normalised poloidal flux coordinate (ρ_pol_norm), defined as sqrt((ψ−ψ_axis)/(ψ_LCFS−ψ_axis)). Standard radial grid coordinate for core plasma 1D profiles, equal to 0 at the magnetic axis and 1 at the LCFS.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/rho_pol_n.label: equilibrium

core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/rho_tor.description: Toroidal flux coordinate (ρ_tor), defined as sqrt(Φ_tor/(π B0)), approximating the effective minor radius. Serves as the primary radial grid coordinate for 1D core plasma profiles.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/rho_tor.label: equilibrium

core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/rho_tor_n.description: Normalized toroidal flux coordinate (ρ_tor,norm), defined as the square root of the toroidal flux normalized to its value at the last closed flux surface (LCFS). A standard radial coordinate for core plasma profiles.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/rho_tor_n.label: equilibrium

core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/volume.description: Volume (V) enclosed inside a magnetic flux surface as a function of the radial grid coordinate in the core profiles. Used as a geometric metric in transport calculations and flux-surface-averaged profile analysis.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/volume.label: equilibrium

core_profiles/profiles_1d/ion/state/z_ma.description: Maximum charge number (Z_max) of an ion charge state bundle in the core plasma profiles. Equal to z_min when the state represents a single charge state rather than a bundled range.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/ion/state/z_ma.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/profiles_1d/ion/state/z_mi.description: Minimum charge state (Z_min) of a charge state bundle for an ion species in the core plasma profiles. Defines the lower bound of the bundled ionization states when multiple charge states are grouped together.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/ion/state/z_mi.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/profiles_1d/ion/z_ion.description: Ion charge (Z_ion) of a given ion species, representing the charge of the dominant ionisation state as a scalar quantity. A radially resolved profile is stored separately as z_ion_1d.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/ion/z_ion.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/profiles_1d/q.description: Safety factor (q) radial profile in the core plasma, representing the ratio of toroidal to poloidal magnetic field line turns per flux surface. A fundamental MHD stability parameter; rational q surfaces are resonant locations for tearing and kink modes.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/q.label: equilibrium

core_profiles/profiles_1d/rotation_frequ.description: Toroidal angular rotation frequency (Ω_tor,sonic) due to the E×B drift, defined as the negative derivative of the flux-surface-averaged electrostatic potential with respect to poloidal flux. Corresponds to the sonic flow approximation of Hinton and Wong (1985).
core_profiles/profiles_1d/rotation_frequ.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/profiles_1d/zeff.description: Effective charge (Zeff) radial profile, the charge-weighted average ionic charge over all species. A key parameter for resistivity, radiation, and transport calculations that quantifies impurity content in the core plasma.
core_profiles/profiles_1d/zeff.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/profiles_2d/ion/state/z_ma.description: Maximum charge number Z (Z_max) of the ion charge state bundle for a given ion state in the 2D core profiles. If no bundling is applied, Z_max equals Z_min, identifying a single charge state.
core_profiles/profiles_2d/ion/state/z_ma.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/profiles_2d/ion/state/z_mi.description: Minimum charge number (Z_min) of the ion charge state bundle for a given ion species in the 2D core plasma profiles. Defines the lower bound of the charge state range grouped together in this bundle.
core_profiles/profiles_2d/ion/state/z_mi.label: core_plasma_physics

core_profiles/vacuum_toroidal_field/r0.description: Reference major radius (R0) at which the vacuum toroidal magnetic field B0 is defined in the core_profiles IDS, typically a fixed geometric position at the vessel equatorial midplane. Used to normalise current densities and define the toroidal flux coordinate rho_tor.
core_profiles/vacuum_toroidal_field/r0.label: equilibrium

core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/psi.description: Poloidal magnetic flux (ψ) as a radial coordinate on the 1D grid for core source term profiles. Labels flux surfaces for mapping source terms to the transport solver radial grid.
core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/psi.label: equilibrium

core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/psi.description: Poloidal magnetic flux (ψ) at the plasma boundary (LCFS), used as a normalization reference defining the outer extent of the radial grid for core source profiles. Provides the boundary condition for the psi coordinate array.
core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/psi.label: equilibrium

core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/rho.description: Normalised poloidal flux coordinate (ρ_pol_norm) on the radial grid for core source profiles, defined as sqrt((ψ−ψ_axis)/(ψ_LCFS−ψ_axis)). Used as a flux-surface label for source term radial profiles.
core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/rho.label: equilibrium

core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/rho.description: Toroidal flux coordinate (ρ_tor) on the 1D radial grid for core source profiles. Defined as ρ_tor = sqrt(Φ_tor/(π·B0)), approximating the effective minor radius of a flux surface.
core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/rho.label: equilibrium

core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/rho.description: Normalised toroidal flux coordinate (rho_tor_norm) used as the radial grid for 1D core source profiles. Normalised to the toroidal flux coordinate at the last closed flux surface (LCFS), spanning 0 at the magnetic axis to 1 at the plasma edge.
core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/rho.label: equilibrium

core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/vol.description: Volume (V) enclosed inside each magnetic flux surface as a function of the radial coordinate, used as a geometric grid quantity for 1D core source profiles.
core_sources/source/profiles_1d/grid/vol.label: equilibrium

core_sources/vacuum_toroidal_field/r0.description: Reference major radius (R0) at which the vacuum toroidal magnetic field B0 is specified in the core_sources IDS, typically a fixed device position. Defines the normalization point for the toroidal flux coordinate ρ_tor and current density expressions.
core_sources/vacuum_toroidal_field/r0.label: equilibrium

disruption/halo_currents/active_wall_poi.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of active wall point.
disruption/halo_currents/active_wall_poi.label: plasma_wall_interactions

disruption/profiles_1d/grid/psi.description: Poloidal magnetic flux (ψ) used as the radial grid coordinate for 1D disruption profiles. Each value labels the flux surface on which the disruption profile data (current density, power loss, runaway electrons) is evaluated.
disruption/profiles_1d/grid/psi.label: equilibrium

distribution_sources/source/profiles_1d/.description: Particle source term for the density transport equation as a 1D radial profile, representing the net volumetric rate of particle production from the distribution source (e.g., NBI ionization, fusion reactions). Used as input for Fokker-Planck and kinetic transport calculations.
distribution_sources/source/profiles_1d/.label: fast_particles

distributions/distribution/ggd/orbit_fre.description: Array of values for orbit frequency pol.
distributions/distribution/ggd/orbit_fre.label: fast_particles

distributions/distribution/global_quanti.description: Power loss due to first orbit losses, where newly born fast particles (e.g., from NBI or fusion reactions) escape before completing a full orbit. A global scalar power sink in the distribution function framework.
distributions/distribution/global_quanti.label: fast_particles

distributions/distribution/profiles_2d/c.description: Collisional toroidal torque density (phi-component) transferred to the thermal ion population in the 2D poloidal plane, arising from Coulomb collisions between the fast particle distribution and bulk thermal ions.
distributions/distribution/profiles_2d/c.label: fast_particles

divertors/divertor/power_currents.description: Power deposited on divertor targets due to electric currents, summed over all targets. Positive values indicate net power deposition from current-driven processes at the divertor.
divertors/divertor/power_currents.label: divertor_physics

divertors/divertor/target/extension_r.description: Radial extent (projection on the major radius axis R) of a divertor target. A geometric parameter characterising the target dimensions in the major radius direction.
divertors/divertor/target/extension_r.label: plasma_wall_interactions

ec_launchers/beam/phase/curvature.description: Inverse curvature radii (1/R) of the phase ellipse for an electron cyclotron (EC) launcher beam in Gaussian optics. Positive/negative values indicate divergent/convergent beam wavefronts; the two components describe the principal curvatures of the beam phase front.
ec_launchers/beam/phase/curvature.label: waves

ece/channel/beam_tracing/beam/position/r.description: Normalised toroidal flux coordinate (ρ_tor_norm) along the ECE beam or ray path, mapping each propagation position to a flux surface. Used to relate beam-tracing positions to plasma radial structure for Te profile reconstruction.
ece/channel/beam_tracing/beam/position/r.label: equilibrium

ece/channel/beam_tracing/beam/wave_vecto.description: Parallel refractive index (n_∥) of the ECE beam or ray along its propagation path, defined as the wave vector component parallel to the local magnetic field normalized by the free-space wave number.
ece/channel/beam_tracing/beam/wave_vecto.label: waves

ece/channel/delta_position_suprathermal/.description: Poloidal angle (θ) component of the position shift of the ECE measurement location induced by suprathermal electrons. Part of the correction vector estimating how non-thermal electrons bias the apparent emission position relative to the thermal resonance layer.
ece/channel/delta_position_suprathermal/.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

edge_profiles/ggd/ion/velocity_over_b_fi.description: Toroidal angle (φ) coordinate of velocity over b field.
edge_profiles/ggd/ion/velocity_over_b_fi.label: core_plasma_physics

edge_profiles/ggd/j_ion_neutral_friction.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of j ion neutral friction.
edge_profiles/ggd/j_ion_neutral_friction.label: edge_plasma_physics

edge_profiles/ggd/j_ion_neutral_friction.description: Radial component of j ion neutral friction.
edge_profiles/ggd/j_ion_neutral_friction.label: edge_plasma_physics

edge_profiles/ggd/vorticity_over_r/z.description: Vertical (Z) coordinate of vorticity over r.
edge_profiles/ggd/vorticity_over_r/z.label: edge_plasma_physics

edge_profiles/profiles_1d/q.description: Safety factor (q) radial profile in the edge and scrape-off layer (SOL) region, representing the ratio of toroidal to poloidal magnetic flux increments per field-line turn. A fundamental MHD stability parameter governing resonant surfaces and field-line connection lengths.
edge_profiles/profiles_1d/q.label: equilibrium

edge_profiles/profiles_1d/rotation_frequ.description: Toroidal angular rotation frequency (Ω_tor,sonic) due to the E×B drift, defined as minus the derivative of the flux-surface-averaged electrostatic potential with respect to poloidal flux. Also referred to as the sonic flow frequency in the edge/SOL region.
edge_profiles/profiles_1d/rotation_frequ.label: core_plasma_physics

edge_transport/model/ggd/ion/momentum/fl.description: Toroidal angle (φ) coordinate of flux limiter.
edge_transport/model/ggd/ion/momentum/fl.label: plasma_wall_interactions

equilibrium/time_slice/boundary/gap/angl.description: Angle of a plasma boundary gap vector measured clockwise from the radial cylindrical direction (grad R). Defines the orientation of the gap used to specify the plasma boundary shape in fixed-boundary equilibrium codes.
equilibrium/time_slice/boundary/gap/angl.label: equilibrium

equilibrium/time_slice/boundary/minor_ra.description: Minor radius (a) of the plasma boundary, defined as (R_max − R_min)/2 of the boundary contour. A primary geometric parameter characterizing the radial extent of the plasma cross-section.
equilibrium/time_slice/boundary/minor_ra.label: equilibrium

equilibrium/time_slice/constraints/n_e_l.description: Measured value of n e line.
equilibrium/time_slice/constraints/n_e_l.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

equilibrium/time_slice/constraints/n_e_l.description: Reconstructed value of n e line.
equilibrium/time_slice/constraints/n_e_l.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

equilibrium/time_slice/global_quantities.description: Vertical velocity (dZ/dt) of the current centre, representing the rate of change of the vertical position of the centroid of the plasma current distribution. A global scalar equilibrium quantity.
equilibrium/time_slice/global_quantities.label: plasma_control

equilibrium/time_slice/global_quantities.description: Normalised poloidal flux coordinate (ψ_norm) at the location of the minimum safety factor (q_min) within the plasma. Used to identify the radial position of q_min on the flux surface grid.
equilibrium/time_slice/global_quantities.label: equilibrium

equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_1d/dvolu.description: Radial derivative of the volume enclosed by a flux surface with respect to poloidal flux (dV/dψ). A geometric metric quantity used in flux-surface averaging, pressure balance calculations, and the formulation of 1D transport equations.
equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_1d/dvolu.label: equilibrium

equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_1d/gm7.description: Flux-surface-averaged metric coefficient gm7 = ⟨|∇ρ|⟩, where ρ is the radial flux coordinate. A geometric quantity appearing in flux-surface-averaged transport equations and gyrokinetic geometry specifications.
equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_1d/gm7.label: equilibrium

equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_1d/j_phi.description: Flux-surface averaged toroidal current density (j_phi), defined as ⟨j_tor/R⟩/⟨1/R⟩. This quantity appears directly in the Grad-Shafranov equation and represents the effective current density driving the poloidal flux distribution.
equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_1d/j_phi.label: equilibrium

gyrokinetics_local/linear/wavevector/eig.description: Normalised perpendicular pressure moment of the perturbed gyrocenter distribution function weighted by the first-order Bessel function J1, for a linear gyrokinetic eigenmode. Represents the perpendicular thermal pressure perturbation in Bessel-weighted gyrocenter space.
gyrokinetics_local/linear/wavevector/eig.label: gyrokinetics

gyrokinetics_local/non_linear/fields_int.description: Normalised perturbed parallel magnetic field (δB_∥) intensity as a 1D profile in ky, summed over kx, time-averaged, and flux-surface averaged in a nonlinear gyrokinetic simulation. Quantifies the electromagnetic compressional fluctuation contribution to turbulent transport.
gyrokinetics_local/non_linear/fields_int.label: gyrokinetics

gyrokinetics_local/non_linear/fields_int.description: Normalised perturbed parallel magnetic field (δB∥) intensity, flux-surface and time-averaged, as a function of wavevectors (kx, ky) from a non-linear gyrokinetic simulation. Characterizes electromagnetic fluctuation amplitude in the parallel magnetic compression channel.
gyrokinetics_local/non_linear/fields_int.label: gyrokinetics

gyrokinetics_local/species/density_log_g.description: Normalised logarithmic density gradient (R/Ln) with respect to the normalised minor radius, a key drive term for density-gradient-driven micro-turbulence in gyrokinetic simulations. Used to characterize turbulent particle transport drives.
gyrokinetics_local/species/density_log_g.label: gyrokinetics

hard_x_rays/channel/detector/outline/x2.description: X2-axis coordinates of the vertices defining the irregular aperture outline of the hard X-ray detector in its local (X1, X2) coordinate system. Used together with x1 to compute the detector geometric etendue and sight-line integrals.
hard_x_rays/channel/detector/outline/x2.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

hard_x_rays/channel/energy_band/detectio.description: Detection efficiency of a hard X-ray detector energy band, giving the probability of detecting a photon that impacts the detector as a function of photon energy. Used for absolute calibration of hard X-ray channel signals.
hard_x_rays/channel/energy_band/detectio.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

hard_x_rays/channel/filter_window/radius.description: Radius of a circular filter window aperture for a hard X-ray diagnostic channel. Used only when the filter window geometry type is set to circular (geometry_type/index = 2).
hard_x_rays/channel/filter_window/radius.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

ic_antennas/antenna/module/coupling_resi.description: Coupling resistance of an ion cyclotron (IC) antenna module, characterizing the resistive part of the antenna loading impedance seen by the transmission line. A key RF coupling efficiency parameter relating launched power to antenna current.
ic_antennas/antenna/module/coupling_resi.label: auxiliary_heating

interferometer/channel/wavelength/phase_.description: Conversion factor from measured interferometric phase to line-integrated electron density (∫ne·dl) for a given wavelength channel. Applied to translate raw phase shifts into physically meaningful line density values.
interferometer/channel/wavelength/phase_.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

langmuir_probes/embedded/ion_saturation_.description: Ion saturation current (I_sat) measured by an embedded Langmuir probe. Proportional to the product of electron density and the Bohm velocity, used to infer local plasma density and heat flux at the plasma-facing target surface.
langmuir_probes/embedded/ion_saturation_.label: particle_measurement_diagnostics

langmuir_probes/reciprocating/plunge/col.description: Ion saturation current (Isat) measured by a reciprocating Langmuir probe collector during a plunge. Isat is the limiting current at large negative bias, proportional to local plasma density and electron temperature at the probe tip.
langmuir_probes/reciprocating/plunge/col.label: particle_measurement_diagnostics

lh_antennas/antenna/row/n_phi.description: Toroidal refractive index (n_phi, equivalent to n∥) of the lower hybrid wave spectrum launched by a waveguide row. Determines the parallel wave number and hence the current drive deposition location in the plasma.
lh_antennas/antenna/row/n_phi.label: auxiliary_heating

magnetics/b_field_phi_probe/turns.description: Number of turns (with sign) in a toroidal field (B_φ) probe coil of the magnetics diagnostic. Determines the effective flux sensitivity of the coil together with the coil cross-sectional area.
magnetics/b_field_phi_probe/turns.label: magnetic_field_diagnostics

magnetics/rogowski_coil/current.description: Measured current enclosed within a Rogowski coil contour, used to determine the net current (e.g., plasma current) threading the coil loop. The sign convention follows the right-hand rule relative to the coil's normal direction.
magnetics/rogowski_coil/current.label: magnetic_field_diagnostics

magnetics/shunt/voltage.description: Voltage measured across shunt resistor terminals (V_first − V_second), used with the shunt resistance to infer the current flowing through divertor or vessel structure segments. Provides time-resolved current measurements in the magnetics diagnostic.
magnetics/shunt/voltage.label: magnetic_field_diagnostics

mhd_linear/time_slice/toroidal_mode/plas.description: Imaginary part of the local shear Alfvén frequency spectrum as a function of radius and root index in linear MHD stability analysis. Represents the damping or growth rate component of Alfvén continuum eigenfrequencies.
mhd_linear/time_slice/toroidal_mode/plas.label: magnetohydrodynamics

mse/channel/detector/radius.description: Radius of the circular detector aperture in the MSE diagnostic channel, applicable only when geometry_type = 2 (circular geometry). Defines the size of the sensitive area for line-of-sight calculations.
mse/channel/detector/radius.label: neutronics

nbi/unit/beamlets_group/tilting/delta_po.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of delta position.
nbi/unit/beamlets_group/tilting/delta_po.label: auxiliary_heating

nbi/unit/source/radius.description: Radius of the circular ion source surface for an NBI injector unit, used only when the source geometry type is circular (geometry_type = 2). Defines the spatial extent of the beam extraction aperture.
nbi/unit/source/radius.label: auxiliary_heating

neutron_diagnostic/detector/aperture/rad.description: Radius of a circular collimating aperture in a neutron diagnostic detector, applicable when geometry_type = 2. Defines the geometric acceptance of the neutron detector collimation for flux and emissivity measurements.
neutron_diagnostic/detector/aperture/rad.label: neutronics

neutron_diagnostic/detector/geometry/x1_.description: Full width of the neutron detector aperture in the X1 direction. This geometric parameter applies only when the aperture geometry type is rectangular (geometry_type = 3).
neutron_diagnostic/detector/geometry/x1_.label: plasma_measurement_diagnostics

ntms/time_slice/mode/rho_tor_norm.description: Normalised toroidal flux coordinate (ρ_tor,norm) at which a neoclassical tearing mode (NTM) magnetic island is centred. Identifies the resonant flux surface location within the plasma for the given mode.
ntms/time_slice/mode/rho_tor_norm.label: magnetohydrodynamics

pellets/time_slice/pellet/path_profiles/.description: Electron density (ne) profile along the pellet ablation path. Provides the local background plasma electron density encountered by the pellet as it traverses the plasma, used in ablation source calculations.
pellets/time_slice/pellet/path_profiles/.label: core_plasma_physics

pellets/time_slice/pellet/path_profiles/.description: Poloidal magnetic flux (ψ, psi) sampled along the pellet trajectory through the plasma. Provides the flux-surface label as a function of position along the pellet path for mapping ablation profiles to magnetic geometry.
pellets/time_slice/pellet/path_profiles/.label: equilibrium

pf_active/coil/element/geometry/arcs_of_.description: Curvature radius of each arc of circle used to describe the cross-sectional contour of a PF coil element via a piecewise arc representation. Each arc is defined by its start point (R, Z) and this radius, with the end given by the start of the next arc.
pf_active/coil/element/geometry/arcs_of_.label: magnetic_field_systems

pf_active/coil/geometry/arcs_of_circle/c.description: Curvature radius of each arc of circle used to describe the cross-sectional contour of an active poloidal field (PF) coil. Each arc is defined by a start point and this radius, with the end point given by the start of the next arc.
pf_active/coil/geometry/arcs_of_circle/c.label: magnetic_field_systems

pf_active/coil/resistance.description: Electrical resistance of a poloidal field (PF) coil winding. Used in circuit models to compute Ohmic dissipation, voltage requirements, and thermal loading of the coil.
pf_active/coil/resistance.label: magnetic_field_systems

pf_active/coil/temperature.description: Conductor temperature values serving as the coordinate axis for the current_limit_max look-up table of a PF coil. Defines the temperature-dependent operating limit on maximum allowable coil current.
pf_active/coil/temperature.label: magnetic_field_systems

pf_passive/loop/element/geometry/arcs_of.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of arcs of circle.
pf_passive/loop/element/geometry/arcs_of.label: magnetic_field_systems

pf_passive/loop/element/geometry/oblique.description: First inclination angle (alpha, α) of the oblique (trapezoidal/parallelogram) cross-sectional geometry of a passive conductor loop element, measured counter-clockwise from the outboard horizontal. Part of the poloidal-plane geometric parameterization.
pf_passive/loop/element/geometry/oblique.label: structural_components

pf_plasma/element/geometry/oblique/alpha.description: Inclination angle alpha (α) of the first parallelogram side of the oblique cross-sectional element geometry, measured counter-clockwise from the outwardly directed horizontal radial vector (grad R). Defines the orientation of the parallelogram for a discrete plasma current-carrying filament.
pf_plasma/element/geometry/oblique/alpha.label: equilibrium

pf_plasma/element/geometry/oblique/lengt.description: Length of the parallelogram side inclined at angle alpha with respect to the major radius axis, describing the oblique cross-sectional geometry of a discrete plasma current filament element.
pf_plasma/element/geometry/oblique/lengt.label: equilibrium

pf_plasma/element/geometry/rectangle/hei.description: Vertical full height of the rectangular cross-section describing a discrete plasma current-carrying filament element. Defines the vertical extent of the current element geometry in the pf_plasma filamentary representation.
pf_plasma/element/geometry/rectangle/hei.label: equilibrium

plasma_initiation/global_quantities/b_fi.description: Stray magnetic field (Bstray) at the plasma position during plasma initiation. Residual fields from imperfect cancellation of external coil fields can inhibit electron avalanche breakdown.
plasma_initiation/global_quantities/b_fi.label: plasma_initiation

plasma_profiles/ggd/ion/velocity_over_b_.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of velocity over b field.
plasma_profiles/ggd/ion/velocity_over_b_.label: core_plasma_physics

plasma_profiles/profiles_1d/ion/state/z_.description: Concentration-weighted mean charge number (⟨Z⟩) of an ion charge-state bundle, volume-averaged over the plasma radius. Computed as Σ(Z·x_z) over all charge states within the bundle; scalar complement to the radial profile z_average_1d.
plasma_profiles/profiles_1d/ion/state/z_.label: core_plasma_physics

polarimeter/channel/ellipticity_initial.description: Initial ellipticity of the probing beam polarization state before entering the plasma, serving as the reference baseline for Cotton-Mouton effect measurements. Defined per polarimeter channel line-of-sight.
polarimeter/channel/ellipticity_initial.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

polarimeter/channel/polarization_initial.description: Initial polarization vector of the probing wave before entering the plasma in a polarimeter channel. Defines the reference polarization state used to measure Faraday rotation and Cotton-Mouton ellipticity induced by the magnetized plasma.
polarimeter/channel/polarization_initial.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

pulse_schedule/position_control/gap/angl.description: Angle of the plasma boundary gap direction measured clockwise from the radial (grad R) direction in the poloidal cross-section. Defines the orientation of the gap vector used as a reference in plasma position control.
pulse_schedule/position_control/gap/angl.label: equilibrium

reflectometer_fluctuation/channel/amplit.description: Measured amplitude of the detected probing wave as a function of swept frequency and time slice. Records the signal strength of the reflected wave returned to the fluctuation reflectometer antenna.
reflectometer_fluctuation/channel/amplit.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

reflectometer_profile/channel/amplitude.description: Measured amplitude of the detected probing microwave signal for each frequency and time slice in a profile reflectometer channel. Sampled at the beginning of each frequency sweep, reflecting wave coupling and reflection conditions at the cutoff layer.
reflectometer_profile/channel/amplitude.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

refractometer/channel/bandwidth/frequenc.description: Main carrier frequency of the probing microwave signal in a refractometer channel, specified before upshifting and modulation. Defines the base frequency used for refractive phase shift measurements of electron density.
refractometer/channel/bandwidth/frequenc.label: electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics

runaway_electrons/global_quantities/volu.description: Volume-averaged kinetic energy density of the runaway electron (RE) population. Represents the mean kinetic energy per unit volume stored in suprathermal runaway electrons averaged over the plasma volume.
runaway_electrons/global_quantities/volu.label: runaway_electrons

soft_x_rays/channel/detector/outline/x1.description: Positions of the soft X-ray detector outline vertices along the X1 axis in the local (X1, X2) coordinate system. Defines part of the polygonal boundary of the detector or aperture used for etendue and line-of-sight calculations.
soft_x_rays/channel/detector/outline/x1.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

soft_x_rays/channel/detector/outline/x2.description: Positions of the soft X-ray detector outline vertices along the x2 axis of the local (X1, X2) coordinate system. Defines the aperture geometry of the detector for line-of-sight and etendue calculations.
soft_x_rays/channel/detector/outline/x2.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

soft_x_rays/channel/etendue.description: Étendue (geometric extent, AΩ) of a soft X-ray diagnostic channel's optical system. Characterizes the product of detector area and solid angle, determining the channel's geometric sensitivity to plasma emission.
soft_x_rays/channel/etendue.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

soft_x_rays/channel/filter_window/outlin.description: Positions of the soft X-ray filter window outline vertices along the X2 axis in the local (X1, X2) coordinate system. Together with X1 positions, defines the irregular boundary shape of the filter window for a soft X-ray channel.
soft_x_rays/channel/filter_window/outlin.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

soft_x_rays/channel/filter_window/x2_wid.description: Full width of the soft X-ray filter window in the X2 direction of its local coordinate frame, applicable when the rectangular geometry type (index=3) is selected. A geometric parameter for the filter aperture description.
soft_x_rays/channel/filter_window/x2_wid.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

spectrometer_uv/channel/detector/outline.description: Positions of the UV spectrometer detector aperture outline vertices along the X1 axis of the local (X1, X2) coordinate system of the detector face. Defines one component of the 2D aperture boundary polygon.
spectrometer_uv/channel/detector/outline.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

spectrometer_uv/channel/detector/radius.description: Radius of the circular front face of the UV spectrometer detector (micro channel plate), applicable only when the detector geometry type is set to circular (geometry_type = 2). Defines the aperture size for optical throughput calculations.
spectrometer_uv/channel/detector/radius.label: spectroscopy

spectrometer_visible/channel/grating_spe.description: Non-calibrated intensity of a processed spectral line from a visible grating spectrometer channel, integrated over the line profile. Unlike the sibling radiance, this is not background-subtracted or absolutely calibrated.
spectrometer_visible/channel/grating_spe.label: spectroscopy

spectrometer_visible/channel/isotope_rat.description: Ratio of the neutral density of a given hydrogen isotope to the summed neutral densities of all other isotopes in the measurement channel. Used to quantify the hydrogen fuel isotope composition from visible spectroscopy.
spectrometer_visible/channel/isotope_rat.label: edge_plasma_physics

spectrometer_visible/channel/light_colle.description: Array of values for light collection efficiencies.
spectrometer_visible/channel/light_colle.label: spectroscopy

spectrometer_visible/channel/polarizatio.description: Line-of-sight projected velocity of hot neutral atoms measured by polarization spectroscopy on a visible spectrometer channel. Positive values correspond to motion from the first to the second point along the line of sight.
spectrometer_visible/channel/polarizatio.label: edge_plasma_physics

spectrometer_x_ray_crystal/channel/cryst.description: Radius of a circular X-ray crystal aperture, applicable only when the geometry type is circular (geometry_type = 2). Defines the physical size of the diffracting crystal used in the X-ray crystal spectrometer channel.
spectrometer_x_ray_crystal/channel/cryst.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

spectrometer_x_ray_crystal/channel/cryst.description: Physical thickness of the Bragg crystal used in an X-ray crystal spectrometer channel. A geometric parameter relevant to X-ray absorption, diffraction efficiency, and spectral resolution.
spectrometer_x_ray_crystal/channel/cryst.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

spectrometer_x_ray_crystal/channel/refle.description: Radius of curvature of the reflector surface in the X2 direction for an X-ray crystal spectrometer channel. Applicable only for specific curvature types (index 3 or 5) in the reflector geometry description.
spectrometer_x_ray_crystal/channel/refle.label: radiation_measurement_diagnostics

spi/injector/fragment/species/density.description: Number density of a given atomic species within a shattered pellet (SPI) fragment. Characterizes the material composition of the individual SPI fragment.
spi/injector/fragment/species/density.label: fueling

spi/injector/fragment/volume.description: Volume of an individual shattered pellet fragment as a function of time or fragment index. Used to characterise the fragment size distribution in shattered pellet injector (SPI) disruption mitigation studies.
spi/injector/fragment/volume.label: fueling

summary/boundary/minor_radius/value.description: Minor radius (a) of the plasma boundary, defined as half the difference between the maximum and minimum major radii of the last closed flux surface. A primary geometric parameter characterizing the plasma cross-section size.
summary/boundary/minor_radius/value.label: equilibrium

summary/fusion/current/value.description: Parallel current driven by fusion reactions within the plasma. A minor contribution to the total non-inductive current, associated with fast alpha particles produced by D-T fusion reactions.
summary/fusion/current/value.label: current_drive

summary/fusion/neutron_rates/total/value.description: Total neutron emission rate (Sn) from all fusion reactions combined, including DT, DD, and TT reactions. Provides the aggregate neutron production rate used for fusion performance characterization.
summary/fusion/neutron_rates/total/value.label: neutronics

summary/gas_injection_rates/bottom/value.description: Gas injection rate from all valves located near near the bottom of the vaccuum chamber.
summary/gas_injection_rates/bottom/value.label: fueling

summary/global_quantities/power_loss/val.description: Total power crossing the separatrix (Psep), representing the net energy loss from the confined plasma through the last closed flux surface into the scrape-off layer.
summary/global_quantities/power_loss/val.label: edge_plasma_physics

summary/global_quantities/power_radiated.description: Total radiated power (Prad) from the plasma, a key global energy balance quantity. Represents power lost from the plasma via electromagnetic radiation across all spectral ranges and emission processes.
summary/global_quantities/power_radiated.label: core_plasma_physics

summary/heating_current_drive/ic/k_perpe.description: Main perpendicular wave number (k⊥) of ion cyclotron resonance heating (ICRH) waves launched by an IC antenna. Characterizes the transverse spatial scale of the wave in the plasma.
summary/heating_current_drive/ic/k_perpe.label: auxiliary_heating

summary/heating_current_drive/lh/current.description: Parallel current driven by lower hybrid (LH) waves (LHCD), representing the non-inductive toroidal current generated by the LH heating and current drive system. A key figure of merit for current profile control scenarios.
summary/heating_current_drive/lh/current.label: current_drive

summary/heating_current_drive/lh/n_paral.description: Main parallel refractive index of LH waves at launch.
summary/heating_current_drive/lh/n_paral.label: waves

summary/pedestal_fits/linear/b_field_tor.description: Toroidal magnetic field (Bt) evaluated at the position of the pressure pedestal top as determined by a linear fit, on the low field side (LFS). Used in pedestal database characterization.
summary/pedestal_fits/linear/b_field_tor.label: equilibrium

summary/pedestal_fits/linear/n_e/pedesta.description: Pedestal position in normalised poloidal flux.
summary/pedestal_fits/linear/n_e/pedesta.label: equilibrium

summary/pedestal_fits/linear/pressure_el.description: Pedestal position in normalised poloidal flux.
summary/pedestal_fits/linear/pressure_el.label: equilibrium

summary/pedestal_fits/mtanh/b_field_tor_.description: Toroidal magnetic field (Bt) calculated at the pedestal top position on the low field side (LFS), as determined by the mtanh pedestal fit. Used for dimensionless parameter calculations in pedestal stability and confinement scaling analyses.
summary/pedestal_fits/mtanh/b_field_tor_.label: equilibrium

summary/volume_average/t_i_average/value.description: Volume-averaged ion temperature (Ti), averaged over all ion species, representing the mean thermal energy of the ion population across the plasma volume. A key global confinement metric.
summary/volume_average/t_i_average/value.label: core_plasma_physics

tf/coil/conductor/cross_section/area.description: Cross-sectional area of a TF coil conductor, derived from the conductor cross-section geometry. Used in electromagnetic and structural analyses of the toroidal field coil system.
tf/coil/conductor/cross_section/area.label: magnetic_field_systems

tf/coil/conductor/resistance.description: Ohmic resistance of a toroidal field (TF) coil conductor. Used to compute resistive power dissipation and voltage drop in the TF coil circuit.
tf/coil/conductor/resistance.label: magnetic_field_systems

tf/coil/resistance.description: Electrical resistance of a toroidal field (TF) coil. Determines ohmic power dissipation during operation and is relevant for thermal management and energy balance of the TF coil system.
tf/coil/resistance.label: magnetic_field_systems

thomson_scattering/laser/end_point/r.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of end point.
thomson_scattering/laser/end_point/r.label: particle_measurement_diagnostics

wall/description_2d/limiter/unit/midplan.description: Nuclear power density deposited in a limiter wall unit at the midplane. Represents volumetric nuclear heating from neutron and gamma interactions at that toroidal location.
wall/description_2d/limiter/unit/midplan.label: neutronics

wall/description_2d/limiter/unit/power_n.description: Nuclear power deposited in a specific limiter or plasma-facing component (PFC) unit of the 2D wall description. Captures the heating contribution from neutron and gamma radiation to the wall structure.
wall/description_2d/limiter/unit/power_n.label: neutronics

wall/description_ggd/ggd/energy_fluxes/c.description: Incident energy flux on wall components (GGD grid subsets) due to current-driven processes. Part of the energy flux decomposition where net wall flux equals incident minus emitted.
wall/description_ggd/ggd/energy_fluxes/c.label: plasma_wall_interactions

wall/global_quantities/electrons/pumping.description: Pumping speed expressed as the pumped particle flux in equivalent electrons. Represents the rate at which electrons (or equivalent particles) are removed from the plasma region by wall pumping processes.
wall/global_quantities/electrons/pumping.label: plasma_wall_interactions

wall/global_quantities/power_to_cooling.description: Power transferred from the plasma-facing wall to the active cooling systems. Represents the total thermal power extracted by cooling, balancing incident plasma heat loads and accounting for energy removal from the tokamak wall.
wall/global_quantities/power_to_cooling.label: plasma_wall_interactions

waves/coherent_wave/beam_tracing/beam/ph.description: Inverse curvature radii (1/R) of the beam phase ellipse for a coherent wave in beam tracing calculations, characterizing wavefront curvature in the horizontal and vertical directions. Positive (negative) values indicate beam divergence (convergence).
waves/coherent_wave/beam_tracing/beam/ph.label: waves

waves/coherent_wave/beam_tracing/beam/po.description: Normalised toroidal flux coordinate (ρ_tor,norm) at each position along the ray or beam path in a wave beam tracing calculation. Maps beam trajectory points to flux surface geometry.
waves/coherent_wave/beam_tracing/beam/po.label: equilibrium

waves/coherent_wave/profiles_1d/ion/stat.description: Flux-surface-averaged absorbed wave power density deposited on the fast (non-thermal) ion population of a given charge state bundle, as a 1D radial profile. Characterises RF heating power density absorbed by fast ions via wave-particle interactions.
waves/coherent_wave/profiles_1d/ion/stat.label: auxiliary_heating

waves/coherent_wave/profiles_1d/power_in.description: Total absorbed wave power (P_abs) inside a flux surface, cumulative volume integral over electrons, ions, and fast populations of the absorbed power density. Represents the radial profile of wave power deposition up to each flux surface.
waves/coherent_wave/profiles_1d/power_in.label: auxiliary_heating

waves/coherent_wave/profiles_2d/ion/stat.description: Absorbed RF wave power density deposited on fast (non-thermal) ions of a given charge state in a 2D poloidal cross-section. Represents the spatial distribution of RF wave energy deposited on fast ions per unit volume.
waves/coherent_wave/profiles_2d/ion/stat.label: auxiliary_heating
